seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Chadds Ford, PA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Chadds Ford, Pennsylvania for 2026: the Brandywine Ice Rink, holiday trains and storytimes in the Brandywine Valley.
lede: Chadds Ford pairs a new outdoor ice rink at the Brandywine Museum of Art with holiday trains and storytimes in the Brandywine Valley.
celebrates: The Brandywine Conservancy and Museum of Art opens a new outdoor ice rink in its courtyard on December 18, 2026. It has real ice, room for up to 65 skaters at a time, and stays open through January 18, 2027. Chadds Ford families also plan around the holiday train displays at the Brandywine Railroad Club, a breakfast with the trains and a Polar Express pajama night, all listed below with links to each host.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for the Brandywine Ice Rink, because the rink is new for the 2026 season. The Brandywine Museum's holiday railroad programs ran in the 2025 season as well, and each card below links to the host page with the current dates and prices.
facts: Chadds Ford had a population of 3,972 at the 2020 census, according to Wikipedia. Its name comes from the Chad family, and the Chad House still stands there. The Battle of Brandywine was fought here on September 11, 1777, and the Brandywine Battlefield preserves the ground. The Brandywine River Museum shows work by the Wyeth family, and the township was renamed from Birmingham Township in 1996.
trains: Chadds Ford is a quiet stop on the Brandywine Valley holiday circuit, and the trains here are model railroads rather than full size rides. For a ride behind a real locomotive, the West Chester Railroad runs Santa's Express from West Chester, and our West Chester guide lists dates and prices.
